# quay_repository (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "quay_organization" "main" {
  name  = "main"
  email = "quay+main@example.com"
}

resource "quay_repository" "test" {
  name        = "test"
  namespace   = quay_organization.main.name
  visibility  = "private"
  description = "test"
}

# A mirrored repository. The platform assigns the repository state to "mirror",
# pulls the configured tags from the upstream registry on the given interval, and
# uses the given robot account to authenticate. Trigger an immediate sync after
# (re)configuring the mirror by setting sync_on_change to true.
resource "quay_repository" "mirror" {
  name        = "mirror"
  namespace   = quay_organization.main.name
  visibility  = "private"
  description = "mirrored upstream images"
  state       = "mirror"

  mirror {
    upstream_repository = "quay.io/argoproj/argocd"
    robot_user          = "main+ci"
    sync_interval       = 86400
    sync_on_change      = true
    verify_tls          = true
    unsigned_images     = false
    root_rule           = { rule_kind = "tag_glob_csv", rule_value = ["*"] }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Repository name
- `namespace` (String) Repository namespace. Should be an organization name or username

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description
- `visibility` (String) Repository visibility. Should be private or public. Defaults to private.
- `mirror` (Block, Optional) Mirroring configuration. Required when state is mirror, forbidden otherwise. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--mirror))
- `state` (String) Repository state. Should be normal, readonly, or mirror. Defaults to normal.

<a id="nestedblock--mirror"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mirror`

Optional:

- `http_proxy` (String) HTTP proxy URL for the upstream registry
- `https_proxy` (String) HTTPS proxy URL for the upstream registry
- `no_proxy` (String) No-proxy list for the upstream registry
- `robot_user` (String) Name of an existing robot account that Quay uses to pull images from the upstream registry. Required when state is "mirror".
- `root_rule` (Attributes) Filtering rule applied to mirrored tags (tag patterns to mirror). Required when state is "mirror". (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mirror--root_rule))
- `sync_interval` (Number) Interval in seconds between mirror syncs. Defaults to the platform default when omitted.
- `sync_on_change` (Boolean) Whether to trigger an immediate mirror sync when the repository is created as a mirror, transitions into the mirror state, or its mirror configuration changes. Defaults to true.
- `sync_timeout` (Number) Number of seconds the mirroring job may run before timing out. Must be at least 300. Defaults to 600. Automatically omitted on Quay versions that do not support this field.
- `unsigned_images` (Boolean) Whether to allow unsigned images to be mirrored. Defaults to false.
- `upstream_password` (String, Sensitive) Password used to pull from the upstream registry (write-only; not returned by the API)
- `upstream_repository` (String) Upstream repository reference to mirror from, e.g. quay.io/argoproj/argocd Required when state is "mirror".
- `upstream_username` (String) Username used to pull from the upstream registry
- `verify_tls` (Boolean) Whether to verify TLS of the upstream registry. Defaults to true.

<a id="nestedatt--mirror--root_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mirror.root_rule`

Optional:

- `rule_kind` (String) Kind of rule, e.g. tag_glob_csv. Required when state is "mirror".
- `rule_value` (List of String) Values of the rule

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# A repository can be imported using its organization and name.
terraform import quay_repository.test org/test
```
